packageRules.description: rust-toolchain.toml carries the declared MSRV, not "latest rust": CI is deliberately pinned so it builds and tests at the MSRV it advertises. Raising it is a compatibility change for downstream consumers and must ride a breaking release, so renovate must not propose it at all - see the revert in 486719c, where a bare bump broke lockstep and had to be rolled back.

A rust-toolchain bump only rewrites rust-toolchain.toml, but the same version is also pinned in Cargo.toml (rust-version), clippy.toml (msrv) and every dtolnay/rust-toolchain@ entry in .github/workflows. A partial bump silently puts CI on a different toolchain than the one it advertises, so never automerge it - update every location together and let scripts/check_toolchain_pins.py confirm.
